blocks.title: Free radical
blocks.text: Free radical woh species hai jis mein ek ya zyada ghair-jure (unpaired) electrons hon.

Ek sada misal azad chlorine atom hai, configuration 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p5 ke saath: 3p subshell mein do orbitals jure electrons rakhte hain aur teesra ek ghair-jura electron, jo symbol ke baad ek nuqte se dikhaya jata hai. Akele atoms ke ilawa atoms ke giroh bhi free radicals ho sakte hain, misal ke taur par hydroxyl radical OH aur methyl radical CH3.

blocks.prompt: Aluminium radical (Z = 13) aur copper radical (Z = 29) ki configurations likhein aur batayein ke har ek mein ghair-jura electron kahan hai.
blocks.explanation: Aluminium 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p1 hai, us ka akela ghair-jura electron 3p mein. Copper 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p6 3d10 4s1 hai, ghair-jura electron 4s mein. Har atom, ek ghair-jura electron rakhne ki wajah se, free radical hai.

items: Free radical mein ek ya zyada ghair-jure electrons hote hain, jo nuqte se dikhaye jate hain: chlorine atom (ek ghair-jura 3p electron), OH, CH3.
